Callout.Name: Pursuit Assistance
Callout.Message: Pursuit passing through, units requested to join.
Callout.Advisory: Pursuit heading north, two units involved.

Script.Line: They went through the junction on red and kept going.
I am second car. I am asking for a third.
I have got the plate and the direction. That is all I have.

Lines.Approach: They are coming through your area now. Join in behind, do not try to head it off.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
